engineeringRoots.commitMessage: Sync changes from NCO's hrrr.v4.1.20 operational directory
lockedFacts: HRRR v4 source is carried in a WRFV3.9 tree, but source identity is the NOAA HRRR operational fork, not merely upstream WRF V3.9
CONUS hrrr_wrf.nl at the locked commit uses mp_physics=28 for the primary domain
calc_effectRad derives radiation effective radii for cloud water, ice and snow and includes explicit lower/upper clamps
is_aerosol_aware is runtime state set by presence of aerosol arguments; mp_physics=28 alone is not a proof of every invocation's runtime branch

lockedUse: compare the bounded calc_effectRad block against the HRRR fork
do not use upstream WRF identity as a substitute for HRRR operational provenance

boundedComparison.result: No textual difference was found in the fetched complete calc_effectRad subroutine between the locked HRRR v4.1.20 source and upstream WRF V3.9. This statement is scoped to calc_effectRad only; the module blobs differ and the operational model is not thereby equivalent to upstream WRF V3.9.
